prompt: Photograph a man recording an online news video in a spare bedroom, taken on a phone propped on a shelf, slightly low and a little crooked. A creased green cloth is pinned to the wall behind him with drawing pins, one corner sagging. A black microphone on a scissor arm crosses the near foreground, out of focus. He leans towards the lens with one gloved finger raised, mid-sentence. His whole head is in a tight cream knitted balaclava with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye, a small red triangle with rounded corners. Black roll-neck, black hoodie, black nitrile gloves. One cheap LED panel on a stand from camera-right lights him hard and leaves the far side of the room dim. Phone-camera sharpness, slight noise in the shadows. Thanks.
